name: Window Sweaters
use_label: Knitted borders for your Mac windows
one_liner: A macOS menu-bar app that dresses your windows in knitted borders.

text.why: An app for mood rather than utility: it adds a bit of warmth to the windows you stare at all day.
text.take: It is simply charming, and needs no better reason.
build: It draws a knitted pattern around each window, in two styles: patterns in each app's colours (Finder, Claude, Codex, Spotify, Notion, Figma and more) or a zigzag in the app colour with cream.

who.role: Mac users who like to decorate their desktop.

start.text: With Homebrew: brew trust saragordic/tap, then brew install --cask saragordic/tap/window-sweaters. The README also suggests handing the repo link to your coding agent to install.

license.scope_text: Use freely. Release your source if you redistribute (copyleft).

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: Borders rendered by Window Sweaters: knitted frames in Finder, Teams, Claude, Codex, Spotify, Notion, WhatsApp and Figma colours, in two patterns.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
